metadata.question: Does the snow cover in northwestern Pennsylvania increase between February 22, 2020, and March 1, 2020?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: - Location: Northwestern Pennsylvania (need to define a geometry) - Dates: February 22, 2020 and March 1, 2020 (two specific dates) - Collection: MODIS snow cover products (MOD10A1 or MYD10A1) or Sentinel-2 with snow indices - Best option: MODIS/006/MOD10A1 (daily snow cover) - has NDSI_Snow_Cover band 2. Masking strategy: - The question is about snow cover, so I should use snow-specific data - MODIS snow product has quality flags - should mask out poor quality pixels - Cloud masking may be needed depending on data quality 3. Logic: - Valid Zero: Snow cover percentage of 0% is valid (no snow) - Calculate total snow-covered area or mean snow cover for both dates - Compare: If March 1 > Feb 22, answer A (Yes, increased) - If March 1 <= Feb 22, answer B (No, did not increase) - Handle C1 (no images), C2 (no valid pixels), C3 (null/invalid results) ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // Define northwestern Pennsylvania region const nwPennsylvania = ee.Geometry.Polygon([ [[-80.5, 42.0], [-80.5, 41.5], [-79.5, 41.5], [-79.5, 42.0], [-80.5, 42.0]] ]); // Define dates const date1 = '2020-02-22'; const date2 = '2020-03-01'; try { // Get MODIS snow cover data const snowCol1 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterDate(date1, ee.Date(date1).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(nwPennsylvania); const snowCol2 = ee.ImageCollection('MODIS/006/MOD10A1') .filterDate(date2, ee.Date(date2).advance(1, 'day')) .filterBounds(nwPennsylvania); const size1 = await snowCol1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = await snowCol2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`Feb 22 images: ${size1}, Mar 1 images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("Missing data for one or both dates"); console.log("C1"); return; } // Get the images const img1 = snowCol1.first(); const img2 = snowCol2.first(); // NDSI_Snow_Cover band: 0-100 (percent snow cover), 200=missing, 201=no decision, 211=night, 237=inland water, 239=ocean, 250=cloud, 254=detector saturated, 255=fill // Mask out non-snow values (keep only 0-100) const snowBand1 = img1.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').updateMask( img1.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').gte(0).and(img1.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').lte(100)) ); const snowBand2 = img2.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').updateMask( img2.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').gte(0).and(img2.select('NDSI_Snow_Cover').lte(100)) ); // Calculate statistics const stats1 = await snowBand1.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: nwPennsylvania, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const stats2 = await snowBand2.reduceRegion({ reducer: ee.Reducer.mean().combine(ee.Reducer.count(), '', true), geometry: nwPennsylvania, scale: 500, maxPixels: 1e9 }).getInfo(); const mean1 = stats1['NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean']; const count1 = stats1['NDSI_Snow_Cover_count']; const mean2 = stats2['NDSI_Snow_Cover_mean']; const count2 = stats2['NDSI_Snow_Cover_count']; console.log(`Feb 22: Mean=${mean1?.toFixed(2)}%, Pixels=${count1}`); console.log(`Mar 1: Mean=${mean2?.toFixed(2)}%, Pixels=${count2}`); if (count1 === 0 || count2 === 0) { console.log("No valid pixels after masking"); console.log("C2"); return; } if (mean1 === null || mean1 === undefined || mean2 === null || mean2 === undefined) { console.log("Calculation failed"); console.log("C3"); return; } if (isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2) || mean1 < 0 || mean1 > 100 || mean2 < 0 || mean2 > 100) { console.log("Invalid snow cover values"); console.log("C3"); return; } // Compare snow cover if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log(`Snow cover increased from ${mean1.toFixed(2)}% to ${mean2.toFixed(2)}%`); console.log("A"); } else { console.log(`Snow cover did not increase (${mean1.toFixed(2)}% to ${mean2.toFixed(2)}%)`); console.log("B"); } } catch (error) { console.log(`Error: ${error.message}`); console.log("D"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
